title: Malignant Voyage
description: A surreal circular painting depicts a green-hooded Grim Reaper holding a melting orange candle, a large sailing ship on dark turbulent waters, and a cracked full moon in a stormy sky. The scene includes purple theater seats, glowing green smiley faces, skeletal hands, swirling vortex, colorful musical notes, dripping keys, and the word MALFEASANCE written across the top.
prompt: Surreal circular dark fantasy painting featuring a hooded Grim Reaper in green robes holding a tall dripping orange candle, an old sailing ship floating on a swirling dark ocean vortex, a large cracked full moon in the night sky, purple dripping theater seats, glowing green smiley faces, skeletal hands reaching from the water, colorful musical notes flowing through the air, old keys with dripping wax, and the word MALFEASANCE written across the top in dripping letters, highly detailed, ominous atmosphere.
